title: {\lambda}Split: Self-Supervised Content-Aware Spectral Unmixing for Fluorescence Microscopy
abstract: arXiv:2603.23647v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In fluorescence microscopy, spectral unmixing aims to recover individual fluorophore concentrations from spectral images that capture mixed fluorophore emissions. Since classical methods operate pixel-wise and rely on least-squares fitting, their performance degrades with increasingly overlapping emission spectra and higher levels of noise, suggesting that a data-driven approach that can learn and utilize a structural prior might lead to improved results. Learning-based approaches for spectral imaging do exist, but they are either not optimized for microscopy data or are developed for very specific cases that are not applicable to fluorescence microscopy settings. To address this, we propose {\lambda}Split, a physics-informed deep generative model that learns a conditional distribution over concentration maps using a hierarchical Variational Autoencoder. A fully differentiable Spectral Mixer enforces consistency with the image

translated_title: λSplit：面向荧光显微镜的自监督内容感知光谱解混方法
translated_abstract: 在荧光显微镜中，光谱解混旨在从捕获了混合荧光团发射信号的光谱图像中恢复各个荧光团的浓度。由于经典方法采用逐像素操作并依赖最小二乘拟合，其性能会随着发射光谱重叠程度的加剧和噪声水平的升高而下降，这表明一种能够学习并利用结构先验的数据驱动方法可能会带来更好的结果。虽然目前存在基于学习的光谱成像方法，但它们要么未针对显微镜数据进行优化，要么是为极特殊的场景开发的，并不适用于荧光显微镜的设置。为解决这一问题，我们提出了λSplit，这是一种融合物理信息的深度生成模型，利用分层变分自编码器学习浓度图的条件分布。一个完全可微分的光谱混合器强制其与图像保持一致性……
tldr: 提出了λSplit，一种基于物理信息的自监督深度生成模型，通过分层变分自编码器学习浓度图的条件分布，并利用可微分光谱混合器，实现了对荧光显微镜光谱图像的内容感知解混。
en_tdlr: λSplit, a physics-informed self-supervised deep generative model that learns conditional distributions over concentration maps via a hierarchical VAE with a differentiable spectral mixer, enabling content-aware spectral unmixing for fluorescence microscopy.
